subject: Q4 review: rating normalization & org move coordination
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@workplacehr.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Q4 review: rating normalization & org move coordination

Team —

I pulled a first-pass calibration package for Q4 and wanted to surface two items before we run the cross-team session next week:

1) Rating distribution drift: engineering managers skewed higher this cycle compared to last year (see "rating_histograms" in the attached PDF). We should consider a normalization step to keep comp and promotion equity consistent across cohorts.
2) Org move impact: the proposed Product Platform consolidation (proposal attached) will change several spans and may re-bucket headcount into different comp bands — HR and Legal need to confirm timing so we can avoid double-counting when making promotion recommendations.

Asks:
- Evelyn, can you review the attached org_change-impact-matrix.xlsx and call out any immediate compensation/leveling constraints?
- Olivia (cc'd), can Workplace HR run a quick equity check vs last cycle and flag any redlines?
- Everyone, please block 60 minutes for a focused calibration on Tuesday 11/25 10:00–11:00 PT if that works.

Attachments (stubs):
- 2025Q4_calibration_pack.pdf (slides + anonymized manager summaries)
- org_change-impact-matrix.xlsx (mapping of roles to new org buckets)

Thanks — I'll circulate a condensed agenda if we lock the time.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Engineering (Product Platform)
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@workplacehr.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T12:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 review: rating normalization & org move coordination

Thanks for the packet, Dylan — good work pulling this together. Quick notes after a first pass: 

- I agree we need a small normalization adjustment; without it we risk inflating promotion bands for teams that ran lighter calibration rigor. Proposal: apply a +/− step normalization only to the top quartile where manager variance > 0.6 SD. I put a comment in the spreadsheet for the affected roles.
- For the Product Platform consolidation: we need Legal to confirm effective date before any promotion offers go out. Aaron (cc'ed on subsequent thread) should weigh in on whether we can mark offers conditional on org realignment.
- We should also flag two outliers (IDs obfuscated in the PDF) for an independent calibration call — I'll raise these during the session if we keep the 60-minute slot.

I can attend Tuesday at 10:00 PT. If others need a different cadence, propose a fallback on Wednesday 11/26 09:00–09:45 PT.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Q4 review: rating normalization & org move coordination

I skimmed the pack — agree with the outlier calls. I'll prepare concise manager talking points for the session (2–3 bullets per outlier).

One quick operational note: can we keep the normalization rule documented as an explicit line in the meeting notes (so compensation has a single source-of-truth)?

I'll be there Tuesday 10:00.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Engineering, Services
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@workplacehr.com>, Aaron Whitaker <aaron@hrlawpartners.com>
Date: 2025-11-24T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Q4 review: rating normalization & org move coordination

Thanks all — final confirmations before the Tuesday session: 

- Meeting: Tue 11/25 10:00–11:00 PT (Calendar invite sent). Please join from laptop; we'll use the Drive packet and shared spreadsheet.
- Normalization rule: Evelyn's proposal (top-quartile adjustment when manager variance > 0.6 SD) will be the working hypothesis. We'll vote during the session and capture the final text in meeting notes (I'll own the note and push to JIRA HROPS-448).
- Org move: Olivia to confirm whether we can publish conditional promotion offers pending Legal sign-off. Aaron, can you confirm the required language and whether a conditional timeline is acceptable?
- Pre-reads: review pages 3–7 of 2025Q4_calibration_pack.pdf and the "org change" tab in org_change-impact-matrix.xlsx.

Attachments referenced: 2025Q4_calibration_pack.pdf (slides), org_change-impact-matrix.xlsx (mapping).

I'll circulate a 1-page meeting agenda and the anonymized talking points tomorrow morning. If anyone needs to escalate ahead of the session (comp exceptions, international local law questions), flag them to me and Evelyn so we can queue Legal/Comp as needed.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Engineering (Product Platform)
Redwood Inference
